answer: An auditor observes that admission should hinge on verifiable presence, not key counts. Each epoch the ledger gives each identity a random berth on a shared wharf and a spiral of unannounced inspections. At its slot the agent signs an arrival record anchored to a berth nonce rotating each round; pre-signed logs fail. Missing two slots means an oasis quarantine tier: earnings freeze until three clean inspections clear it. A sybil farm must staff every berth with independent live responders; idle clones sink as fast as honest work accrues.
